name: rpgym
description: RPGym — app personal de gimnasio gamificada, empaquetada con Capacitor.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleRelease
scripts.bundle: npm run build && npx cap sync android && android\gradlew.bat -p android bundleRelease
